_note: Contiki-NG on the ESP32-C6 (github.com/joakimeriksson/contiki-ng-esp32, -DCONTIKI_NULLNET=ON -DCONTIKI_DISPLAY=ON) as an unmodified IDF app on the Waveshare ESP32-C6-LCD-1.47: Contiki's own scheduler, CSMA and 802.15.4 stack over the emulated MAC, broadcasting every 5 s; its log console on the ST7789 over SPI2+GDMA (BOOT switches to the status view) and its heartbeat on the WS2812 through Contiki's LED driver. bb_init is the PHY blob's baseband calibration, as for the energy scanner.
